Your current `.gitignore` already covers the build/test artifacts that actually exist:

```
/target/
/.deadreckon-smoke/
/.test-tmp/
```

For a Rust project on macOS, a few common additions are worth having even though nothing's leaking yet:

- **`.DS_Store`** — macOS Finder droppings (you're on darwin; it's only a matter of time)
- **`.env`, `.env.local`** — in case you ever stash provider API keys locally
- **`.vscode/`, `.idea/`, `*.iml`** — editor/IDE metadata
- **`*.swp`, `*.swo`, `*~`** — vim/emacs scratch files

Things to **keep tracked** (don't add):
- `Cargo.lock` — correct to commit for a binary/workspace like this
- `crates/*/target/` — workspace shares the root `target/`, already covered

Want me to append those to `.gitignore`?
